contexts: Hi, I'm Dr. Ranj Singh. I'm an NHS children's doctor and I'm going to talk to you about looking after your child with fever. Fever is a high temperature of 38° centigrade or more. Here are a few simple things that you can do at home to help them feel more comfortable. Check your child's temperature regularly.
